source: Binance Spot REST API /api/v3/klines via binance-cli
volumeRatioDefinition: signal base-asset volume divided by mean base-asset volume of previous 20 complete days, excluding signal day
returnDefinition: end close / start close - 1; a calendar month uses previous month-end close as start
caveats: A snapshot and case study, not an out-of-sample trading strategy test.
Daily OHLC does not establish intraday ordering of entry, stop and target.
NEARBTC direct market closes may differ slightly from NEARUSDT/BTCUSDT synthetic ratios.
